opening.argument: The promotion ties access to advertised Bitcoin, Tesla, Ethereum, and other prizes to concrete account and funding requirements. Viewers are instructed to create a Bybit account through the supplied link, then deposit at least $100 in selected cryptocurrencies; every eligible deposit is presented as earning both a reward and a daily lottery ticket. Trading and collecting six unique crypto cards are further promoted as ways to obtain additional tickets and greater rewards. This structure makes acquiring rewards contingent on low-barrier account creation, deposits, and activity, while the available evidence does not establish that prizes were awarded, funds were transferred, or the offer terms and destination were independently verified.

citations.quote: Step 1. Create your Bybit account now through our link. See the description to get the link.
Step 2. Deposit fund your account with at least $100 in select cryptocurrencies like SOL, XRP, DOGE, LINK, and more.
Every eligible deposit earns you a reward and a lottery ticket for daily prizes.
Step 3. Trade Every Trade lets you collect crypto cards, gather 6 unique cards, and you can combine them to form a lottery ticket for even greater rewards.
